notes: Metric: wall time of `node platform/pages/check.mjs <dist>` on a fresh `PAGES_CARD_CACHE=... node build.mjs --out=<dist> --audio-cdn` build (11,937 pages), 4-core container. Before/after taken interleaved (old,new x3) with date +%s.%N for total and performance.now() around the link pass's mapLimit. Link pass median 7.1 s -> 3.7 s; total median 20.5 s -> 16.2 s (~21%). Sequential runs drifted +/-1 s, hence interleaving. Output byte-identical (cmp) on the real artifact and on one with 9 planted bad links (both exit 1, 10 problems). New oracle test vs path.resolve (>1,000 cases), two mutants both caught; check.test.mjs 99/99. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: 6/6 selected workflows passed (120 steps ok; portfolio-pages 12/12 run steps); not run locally: agent-cross-review jobs and portfolio-pages gate/deploy jobs (CI-only).
